children: Equity Bancshares signed a definitive Agreement and Plan of Reorganization to acquire Lincoln Bancorp through a two-step merger, ultimately combining Lincoln Savings Bank into Equity Bank. Consideration is targeted at 77.5% stock and 22.5% cash, with proration and adjustments tied to Lincoln’s delivered capital, merger costs, and certain credit resolutions; a $750,000 increase is possible upon meeting LSBX wind-down milestones. To support approval, Equity secured a Voting Agreement from holders of about 15% of Lincoln shares and obtained Director Support Agreements imposing two-year post-closing covenants. One mutually agreed Lincoln director will join Equity’s board following closing.
